g.text: A fill leaves only after both stream cores have released what it needs
07 §4.1 · cores and rings of the order stream
CTPIO → port A.a, port B.a; sfence
CTPIO → port A.b, port B.b; sfence
R_fill_X: fills tagged (s, need_A, need_B), X = the TX core of the recipient's port
wait: released[A] ≥ need_A(s) and released[B] ≥ need_B(s), then CTPIO fill
lanes: every response of op q waits for LaneCut[l].cut ≥ q (written by l's stream core after sfence)
every ring is SPSC except R_step
